tagline: Crafting Culinary Leaders, Empowering Global Careers.

mission.heading: Global Mission
mission.text: To provide authoritative, high-velocity culinary education that meets NSDA and international standards while upholding professional excellence.

vision.heading: Future Vision
vision.text: To be the leading vocational powerhouse in South Asia, producing professional chefs recognized globally for their skill, discipline, and technical sharpness.

items.title: Food & Beverage Production
items.desc: Mastering 120+ authentic recipes across 16+ countries with NSDA Level-2 & 3 training.

items.title: Professional Baking & Pastry
items.desc: Technical science of artisanal breads and pâtisserie (Bonus module included).

items.title: Culinary Entrepreneurship
items.desc: ROI-focused training for launching high-profit commercial kitchens and industrial management.

process.heading: The CIB Industrial Process
steps: Assessment: NSDA skill evaluation and orientation into international standards.
Immersion: 36 intensive practical sessions covering 120+ global recipes.
Mentorship: Guided technical labs focusing on high-velocity commercial production.
Placement: Performance-based internship and career readiness support.

compliance.heading: Institutional Compliance
items: NSDA: Approved Skill Training Provider (STP) under the Prime Minister's Office.
ISO-HACCP: Training aligned with global food safety and hygiene standards.
Professional Certification: Providing NSDA Level-2 & 3 and ISO-22000 aligned training.
